data.title: Fix a reproducible bug with Claude Code
data.summary: Move from a concrete failure to a minimal reviewed diff with meaningful regression evidence.

facts.text: Claude Code documents debugging from reproduction details, inspecting errors, applying focused changes and running tests.

prerequisites: Access to Claude Code; check account, client and workspace availability.
Reproduction steps, error output and the intended behavior.
steps: Inspect existing code and tests for the failure before modifying anything.
Reproduce the issue with a focused case; capture baseline failure.
Explain the cause and propose the smallest compatible fix.
Apply the change in the authorized checkout and run the same case plus relevant existing checks.
Review the diff for unrelated edits; report exact results, limits and rollback information.
data.output: a minimal fix and failing-before/passing-after evidence
validation: Report the attempted inputs and missing evidence; do not claim a fix.
Preserve them and scope the diff to the requested change.
limitations: Sintra-authored procedure based on provider documentation or demonstrations; no execution in the named app was performed.
Availability and results depend on your inputs, enabled tools and permissions; a suggested practice result is not a measured outcome.
data.prompt: Investigate [reproduction and expected behavior] in this authorized checkout. Inspect existing implementation and tests, then capture a focused baseline failure. Explain the cause and make the smallest compatible fix. Run the same case and relevant existing checks; distinguish baseline failures from new regressions. Preserve unrelated edits. Return a reviewable diff, failing-before/passing-after evidence and any untested behavior.
tips: Give the exact failure, not just “make it work.”
A green test suite does not establish that the reported bug was exercised.
